scenario_row.status_rule: exactly CONSISTENT when drift_flags is empty otherwise exactly DRIFT_DETECTED; never ok or other aliases
scenario_row.flag_id_pattern: scenario_id colon colon region_id colon colon sample_id colon colon event_seq where event_seq is four zero padded decimal digits; METADATA_CORRUPT uses underscore in both region and sample segments when region_id and sample_id are empty; STALE_CALIBRATION uses the SET_CALIBRATION region_id in the region segment and underscore only in the sample segment; post replay audit REGION_DIVERGENCE and FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT must use the actual sample_id in both flag_id third segment and sample_id field never underscore
scenario_row.region_divergence_detail: canonical_predicted_class comma divergent_region_id where canonical region is lexicographically smallest region_id with inference for that sample
scenario_row.feature_scale_drift_threshold: emit FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT when normalized L2 distance for the same sample_id across two regions is strictly greater than 0.5; flag region_id is the compared non canonical region and detail is the canonical region_id

consistency_hash_field.value: lowercase sha256 hex of the compact json array of inference records described in rule_catalog.json consistency_hash
consistency_hash_field.record_filter: only samples whose probabilities array is non-empty (ran inference)
consistency_hash_field.compact_separators: comma and colon with no spaces

encoding.object_keys_alphabetical: every JSON object in the report must serialize keys in strict alphabetical order at all nesting levels
encoding.empty_arrays: drift_flags normalized_features quantized dequantized and probabilities must be json empty arrays when unset never null or omitted
encoding.drift_flags_empty_array: drift_flags must be [] not null when no flags were emitted

inference_without_lock_row.rule: RUN_INFERENCE without LOCK_SAMPLE must emit a sample row with empty normalized_features quantized and dequantized arrays and populated probabilities
inference_without_lock_row.scenario_58_example: sample s9 with predicted_class 0 and empty feature arrays

stale_calibration_flag.detail: version string from the stale SET_CALIBRATION event
